    is_blocked:bool
    blocked_until:Optional[float]=None

main.add_key_record.source_code:
def add_key_record(id:str,key_str:str):
    now=_now()
    expires_at=now+KEY_LIFETIME_SECONDS
    info=keyInfo(
        id=id,
        key=key_str,
        created_at=now,
        expires_at=expires_at,
        is_blocked=False,
        blocked_until=None,
    )
    keys[id]=info
    available.add(id)
    push_expiry(id,expires_at)
